author: ghyls
body:
#### PR description:

Add a `DumpDependencyGraph` service, which dumps the module dependencies of a process as `.json`. This `.json` can then be parsed by other modules.


A use case will be the part of the `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore` package that, from a single-process CMSSW configuration, generates a client and a server-side configurations. This operation requires as input the list of modules intended to be offloaded to the server process. The `DumpDependencyGraph` service is used to understand which products need to be sent forth and back between the client and the server, and how `EDFilters` should be placed in the server configuration so that offloaded modules run only when needed. The changes in `HeterogeneousCore/MPICore` will come later as a separate PR.


#### PR validation:

A test has been added consisting on three files:

`FWCore/Services/test/test_dumpDependencyGraph_cfg.py`
- Defines the initial CMSSW configuration that will be taken as input by `DumpDependencyGraph`

`FWCore/Services/test/test_dumpDependencyGraph_check.py`
- A python script that will parse the generated `.json`, and check that its contents match what `test_dumpDependencyGraph_cfg.py` declared.

`FWCore/Services/test/test_dumpDependencyGraph.sh`
- Run `cmsRun test_dumpDependencyGraph_cfg.py`, then run `python3 test_dumpDependencyGraph_check.py`. `exit 0` if both commands succeeded, fail otherwise.
title: Add a DumpDependencyGraph service to FWCore/Services
